sql: SELECT platform, SUM(spend_ngn) AS total_spend_ngn, SUM(impressions) AS total_impressions, SUM(clicks) AS total_clicks, SUM(spend_ngn)/NULLIF(SUM(clicks),0) AS cpc_ngn FROM kola.ad_platform WHERE city='Accra' AND month IN ('2026-05','2026-06','2026-07') GROUP BY platform ORDER BY total_spend_ngn DESC
